body:
## Scope

Complete the DPI subsystem to cover the full Ch 35 import surface used in real testbenches.

### In scope
- \`import "DPI-C" task\` — void C functions called as SV tasks (blocking context)
- \`output\` and \`inout\` DPI arguments: write-back from C into SV variables after call
- \`chandle\` type: opaque C pointer round-tripped through SV
- Open array args: \`import "DPI-C" function void f(input int a[])\`
- \`export "DPI-C" function/task\` — expose SV functions to C callers

### Out of scope
- Struct/packed union DPI passing (complex ABI, separate phase)
- \`DPI-C\` context tasks (require full UVM process model)

## Key Files
- \`vvp/vvp_dpi.cc\` — write-back mechanism for output args
- \`vvp/vthread.cc\` — \`of_DPI_CALL_*\` output arg write-back; chandle stack
- \`tgt-vvp/vvp_process.c\` — \`draw_dpi_func_body\` for task and output args
- \`iverilog/elaborate.cc\` — \`chandle\` type elaboration, export wiring

## Success Criteria
\`\`\`systemverilog
// dpi_output_test.sv
import "DPI-C" function void c_divmod(input int a, input int b,
                                       output int q, output int r);
module top;
  int q, r;
  initial begin
    c_divmod(17, 5, q, r);
    assert(q == 3 && r == 2);
    \$display("DPI OUTPUT TEST: PASS");
  end
endmodule
\`\`\`
title: Phase 9: DPI completeness — tasks, output/inout args, chandle, open arrays
